merged.title: chore(progress): refresh ByteMatch to 3,303 of 9,100 functions
merged.author: llesieur99
merged.untrustedBody:
## What

Refresh the maintainer progress snapshot from merged master `ec03034` using a fresh complete build. This report-only PR updates the two generated files together so ByteMatch and the README publish the same measurements.

- Code: **360,448 / 5,533,600 bytes (6.51%)**, previously 318,088 bytes (5.75%).
- Finished distinct functions: **3,303 / 9,100**, previously 2,941. This includes **3,052 C functions and 251 original assembly routines** marked `ASM_FUNC`.
- Level C placements: **41,101**, previously 38,445. Repeated level copies do not inflate the distinct function total.
- Boot data remains **0 / 383,391 bytes** matched; level data is not measured.

No source, build recipe, game data or proprietary tool is changed or uploaded. This is the maintainer regeneration of the shared progress files after merged contributions, rather than a function-contribution PR carrying its own report update.

## Checked

- Rebuilt `tools/compiler/build.sh` from the current hash-checked recipe in
